title: 雪梨港灣大橋~Sydney Harbour Bridge
focus: 以 503 公尺雙鉸鋼拱、錨碇鋼索懸臂架設與六百萬顆鉚釘，承載公路與鐵路跨越雪梨港~Carrying road and rail across Sydney Harbour on a 503 m two-hinged steel arch erected by cable-anchored cantilevering and joined by six million rivets
summary: 雪梨港灣大橋是跨度 503 公尺的雙鉸鋼拱橋，拱頂高出水面 134 公尺，橋面同時承載公路、鐵路、自行車道與人行道，1932 年通車。本課從雙鉸拱的推力與荷載路徑出發，分析桁架深度變化、鉚接與支承銷，再拆解兩岸以 128 條隧道錨碇鋼索支撐半拱懸臂架設、1930 年拱頂合龍與 1932 年 96 輛機車的載重試驗，最後談鉚接細節的疲勞評估、大面積塗裝維護，以及作為工程遺產的修繕與交接。~Sydney Harbour Bridge is a two-hinged steel arch spanning 503 m, its crown 134 m above the water, carrying road, rail, cycleway and footway since 1932. Starting from the thrust and load path of a two-hinged arch, the course examines varying truss depth, riveting and bearing pins, then the cantilever erection of each half-arch held back by 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels, the 1930 crown closure and the 1932 load test with 96 locomotives, ending with fatigue assessment of riveted details, painting of a vast steel surface and repair and handover of an engineering heritage structure.

units.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑~Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch
units.mechanism: 雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。橋面以吊桿懸掛在拱下，同時承載公路、兩條鐵路、自行車道與人行道；四座以花崗岩飾面的橋塔位於拱端，主要是建築與視覺作用，並不承擔拱的推力。~The bridge consists of two parallel arch trusses, each supported only by hinges at its two ends on the abutments, making it a two-hinged arch: the supports can rotate but not move horizontally, so the weight of the arch and deck travels mainly as axial compression along the ribs to the supports, producing a large horizontal thrust resisted by sandstone and concrete abutments on each shore. The deck hangs from the arch on vertical hangers and carries road lanes, two railway tracks, a cycleway and a footway; the four granite-faced pylons at the arch ends are mainly architectural and visual and do not resist the arch thrust.
units.model: 拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。取 w = 700 kN/m（恆載加活載）、L = 503 m、拱矢 f = 120 m：H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN；每側垂直反力 V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN。每側兩個支承各分擔一半，單一支承合力 ≈ √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN。w 與 f 為教學假設。~For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f). With w = 700 kN/m (dead plus live), L = 503 m and rise f = 120 m, H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN, and the vertical reaction per side is V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN. Each side has two bearings sharing half, so one bearing's resultant is about √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN. w and f are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力；橋台的抗推力以岩盤承載與滑動檢核驗證；營運期以測量監測橋台與支承的位移，任何水平位移都會改變拱的內力分布。~Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions; verify abutment thrust resistance by rock bearing and sliding checks; in service monitor abutment and bearing movements by survey, since any horizontal movement changes the arch's internal forces.
units.failure: 若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。~If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path.
units.misconception: 雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。~The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust.
units.practice: 評估或改建前應先依原設計與竣工資料畫出明確的荷載路徑圖，標示受力構件與非結構構件；任何鄰近橋台的開挖或隧道工程都要先檢核對橋台水平位移的影響並設監測。~Before assessment or alteration, draw an explicit load-path diagram from original design and as-built records that separates structural from non-structural elements; any excavation or tunnelling near the abutments must first be checked for its effect on horizontal movement and monitored.

units.anchor: 拱肋桁架深度~Arch truss depth
units.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載~Truss depth and unbalanced loading
units.mechanism: 拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。如果荷載完全均勻並與拱軸吻合，拱只受軸壓；但列車、車流只佔半跨時，拱會產生彎矩，由上下弦桿的拉壓差承擔。桁架越深，同樣彎矩造成的弦桿力越小，所以在彎矩較大的區域加深桁架是有效率的做法。溫度變化也會讓雙鉸拱產生內力與變形：公開資料指出，炎熱天氣時拱頂可升高約 18 公分。~The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons. If loading were perfectly uniform and matched the arch axis, the arch would be in pure compression; but trains and traffic on half the span cause bending, carried as a push–pull difference between top and bottom chords. The deeper the truss, the smaller the chord forces for the same moment, so deepening the truss where moments are larger is efficient. Temperature also causes forces and movement in a two-hinged arch: public sources note that the crown can rise by about 18 cm on hot days.
units.model: 弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。若半跨活載在某斷面產生 M = 400,000 kN·m：在桁架深 h = 30 m 處 ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN；若同樣彎矩出現在拱頂 h = 18 m 處，ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN，增加約 67%。彎矩值為教學假設。~Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h. If half-span live load produces M = 400,000 kN·m at a section where h = 30 m, ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN; the same moment at the crown with h = 18 m gives ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN, about 67% more. The moment is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。~Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains.
units.failure: 若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。~Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls.
units.misconception: 拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。~An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered.
units.practice: 拱橋評估必須包含半跨與偏心荷載排列及溫度組合，並列出每類桿件的最不利工況；量測資料應附溫度紀錄，避免把溫度內力誤判為荷載效應。~Arch assessment must include half-span and eccentric load patterns with temperature combinations and list the governing case for each member type; measurement data should carry temperature records so thermal forces are not mistaken for load effects.

units.title: 鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘~Steel, workshops and six million rivets
units.mechanism: 大橋鋼構總重約 52,800 公噸，其中拱約 39,000 公噸。承包商 Dorman Long 在北岸米爾森斯角設置兩座加工廠，把鋼板與型鋼加工成桁架構件，公開資料指出約八成的拱段鋼材由英國預先成形後運來。構件之間以鉚接連接，全橋約有六百萬顆手工打製的鉚釘：鉚釘加熱到紅熱後插入孔中打成頭，冷卻收縮把板件夾緊，主要以釘身受剪與孔壁承壓傳力。鉚接沒有現代高強度螺栓那樣可靠的預拉力，因此接頭的行為更依賴孔的精度與鉚釘填孔程度。~The steelwork weighs about 52,800 t, about 39,000 t of it in the arch. The contractor Dorman Long set up two workshops at Milsons Point on the north shore to fabricate plates and sections into truss members, and public sources say about four-fifths of the arch steel arrived pre-formed from England. Members were joined by about six million hand-driven rivets: each was heated red-hot, inserted and headed, shrinking as it cooled to clamp the plies, transferring force mainly by shank shear and bearing on the hole walls. Riveting lacks the reliable preload of modern high-strength bolts, so joint behaviour depends more on hole accuracy and how well rivets fill their holes.
units.model: 鉚釘直徑 d = 25 mm，面積 A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²；容許剪應力取 100 MPa，單剪容量約 49.1 kN，雙剪約 98.2 kN。傳遞 10,000 kN 構件力需 10,000/98.2 ≈ 102 顆鉚釘。直徑與容許應力為教學假設。~A rivet of d = 25 mm has A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²; at an allowable shear stress of 100 MPa it carries about 49.1 kN in single shear and 98.2 kN in double shear. Transferring a 10,000 kN member force needs 10,000/98.2 ≈ 102 rivets. Diameter and allowable stress are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 評估時以原始圖說核對接頭鉚釘數量與排列，並以敲擊、目視或超音波檢查鬆動鉚釘與鉚釘頭腐蝕；鋼材取樣做拉伸與衝擊試驗，確認當年鋼材的強度與韌性，作為容量計算的依據。~In assessment, check rivet numbers and layouts against original drawings, look for loose rivets and corroded heads by tapping, visual or ultrasonic checks, and test steel samples in tension and impact to establish the strength and toughness of the original steel as the basis for capacity.
units.failure: 鉚釘頭腐蝕或鬆動後，接頭夾緊力喪失，板件之間產生相對滑動與磨損，孔壁承壓集中而出現裂紋；若以現代鋼材性質假設評估百年前的鋼材，可能高估韌性，低溫下的脆性破壞風險被忽略。~Corroded or loose rivet heads lose clamping, letting plies slip and wear and concentrating bearing at hole edges until cracks form; assessing century-old steel with modern material properties can overestimate toughness and overlook brittle-fracture risk.
units.misconception: 鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。~Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies.
units.practice: 歷史鋼橋評估應先做材料試驗與接頭盤點，再決定容量計算的假設；發現鬆動鉚釘時以一對一的方式記錄位置與處置，替換方式需依保存原則與結構需求由工程與遺產雙方共同核定。~Assessment of historic steel bridges should start with material testing and a joint inventory before fixing capacity assumptions; loose rivets are logged one by one with location and action, and replacement methods agreed jointly by engineering and heritage authorities according to conservation principles and structural needs.

units.anchor: 支承銷與橋台~Bearing pins and abutments
units.title: 支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔~Bearing pins, abutments and pylons
units.mechanism: 雙鉸拱的鉸接點必須讓拱端自由轉動、同時傳遞巨大的推力與垂直力。雪梨港灣大橋每片桁架在每端以大型支承銷座在橋台的支承上，銷與銷座之間的接觸應力、轉動摩擦與潤滑決定鉸接是否真的像鉸。橋台把推力傳到砂岩岩盤，花崗岩飾面的橋塔則矗立在橋台上方，公開資料明確指出它們是建築性的、不承擔主結構荷載。鉸接若因腐蝕或磨耗而卡住，拱的實際行為會偏離雙鉸假設，溫度變化在支點處產生額外彎矩。~The hinges of a two-hinged arch must let the arch ends rotate freely while transmitting huge thrust and vertical forces. Each truss end sits on a large bearing pin seated in abutment bearings, and contact stress, rotational friction and lubrication between pin and seat decide whether the hinge truly acts as a hinge. Abutments pass the thrust into sandstone rock, and the granite-faced pylons stand above them; public sources state clearly that they are architectural rather than structural. If corrosion or wear seizes a hinge, the arch departs from two-hinged behaviour and temperature changes induce extra moments at the supports.
units.model: 單一支承合力 R ≈ 127,500 kN（承前單元假設），若支承銷直徑 d = 0.37 m、承壓長度 l = 4.2 m，平均投影承壓應力 σ = R/(d·l) = 127.5/(0.37×4.2) ≈ 82 MPa。銷徑與長度為教學假設。~Taking a bearing resultant R ≈ 127,500 kN from the previous unit's assumptions, a pin of diameter d = 0.37 m and bearing length l = 4.2 m has an average projected bearing stress σ = R/(d·l) = 127.5/(0.37×4.2) ≈ 82 MPa. Pin diameter and length are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期檢查支承銷周圍有無腐蝕產物、磨耗痕跡與潤滑狀況，並量測拱端在不同溫度下的轉角，確認鉸接仍能轉動；橋台以精密測量監測水平與垂直位移，與歷史紀錄比較。~Inspect around the bearing pins for corrosion products, wear marks and lubrication, and measure arch-end rotation at different temperatures to confirm the hinges still turn; monitor abutment horizontal and vertical movement by precise survey against historical records.
units.failure: 支承銷卡滯時，雙鉸拱局部變成固定拱，溫度與活載在拱端產生原設計沒有考慮的彎矩，可能使端部桿件或接頭過應力；銷座腐蝕產生的膨脹也會改變接觸條件，造成應力集中。~A seized pin turns the two-hinged arch locally into a fixed arch, so temperature and live load create end moments the original design never considered, possibly overstressing end members or joints; expanding corrosion in the seat alters contact and concentrates stress.
units.misconception: 鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。~Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance.
units.practice: 支承鉸接應列為關鍵構件，訂定檢查週期、潤滑與防蝕程序，並以轉角與溫度的量測紀錄判斷是否仍有效；任何支承維修都要先評估施工期間的臨時荷載路徑並設停留點。~Hinged bearings should be classed as critical components with set inspection intervals and lubrication and corrosion-protection procedures, judged effective by rotation-versus-temperature records; any bearing repair needs a prior assessment of the temporary load path and hold points.

units.title: 懸臂架設與錨碇鋼索~Cantilever erection with anchor cables
units.mechanism: 雪梨港在架設時不能設置中間支架，兩個半拱只能從兩岸同時向港中央懸臂伸出。每個半拱在完成前都像一支從支承銷伸出的長懸臂，自重會讓它繞支承銷向港內傾倒；因此在兩岸岩盤中開挖 U 形隧道，以 128 條鋼索穿過隧道並連接到半拱上弦，把傾覆力矩拉回岸上。拱上各有一台爬升吊機沿著已完成的上弦向前移動，逐段吊裝新構件；隨著懸臂變長，鋼索拉力持續增加，必須依計算逐步調整。~No intermediate falsework was possible in the harbour, so the two half-arches were cantilevered simultaneously from each shore toward the centre. Until completed, each half-arch acts like a long cantilever from its bearing pin, its weight trying to rotate it into the harbour; so U-shaped tunnels were cut into the rock on each shore and 128 steel cables passed through them and connected to the top chord of the half-arch, pulling the overturning moment back to shore. A creeper crane on each half moved forward along the completed top chord, lifting each new piece; as the cantilever grew, the cable pull increased and was adjusted step by step to calculation.
units.model: 以半拱接近完成時估算：半拱鋼重約 39,000/2 = 19,500 t，即約 191 MN；若重心距支承銷水平 110 m、錨索對支承銷的力臂 55 m，所需拉力 T = W·x/h = 191×110/55 ≈ 383 MN，平均每條鋼索約 383/128 ≈ 3.0 MN。重心與力臂為教學假設。~Near completion, each half-arch weighs about 39,000/2 = 19,500 t, about 191 MN; with its centroid 110 m from the pin horizontally and a cable lever arm of 55 m about the pin, the required pull is T = W·x/h = 191×110/55 ≈ 383 MN, about 383/128 ≈ 3.0 MN per cable on average. Centroid and lever arm are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每吊裝一段後量測半拱端點高程與平面位置，並量測代表性錨索的拉力，與施工階段計算比較；錨碇隧道的岩體與錨座在架設前做驗證試驗，確認能承受設計拉力並有餘裕。~After each segment, survey the half-arch tip level and position and measure selected cable forces against staged calculations; before erection, proof-test the anchorage tunnels' rock and seats to confirm the design pull with margin.
units.failure: 若錨索拉力分配不均，某些鋼索超載而斷裂，半拱的傾覆平衡被打破；錨碇岩體若有未發現的弱面，隧道錨座在巨大拉力下滑動，懸臂端下沉並可能造成倒塌。~Uneven cable force distribution can overload and break some cables, upsetting the half-arch's balance against overturning; an undetected weak plane in the anchorage rock can let the tunnel seat slide under the huge pull, dropping the cantilever tip and risking collapse.
units.misconception: 鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。~A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support.
units.practice: 懸臂架設計畫應列出每個階段的錨索拉力、端點高程與允差，以及錨碇驗證試驗結果；每階段完成後由設計者與施工者共同確認量測值在允差內，才可進入下一段吊裝。~The cantilever erection plan should list cable forces, tip levels and tolerances for each stage together with anchorage proof-test results; after each stage the designer and builder jointly confirm measurements within tolerance before the next lift.

units.title: 1930 年拱頂合龍~The 1930 crown closure
units.mechanism: 兩個半拱伸到港中央時，端點之間預留一段間隙，接著以逐步放鬆錨索的方式讓兩個半拱繞支承銷向內、向下轉動，直到在拱頂相接；公開資料指出兩個半拱在 1930 年 8 月 19 日首次接合，鉚接完成後拱即可自我支撐，錨索隨後拆除。合龍時間對溫度非常敏感：白天日照使鋼材膨脹、間隙縮小，夜間冷卻又使間隙擴大，因此放索與接合必須配合溫度變化，確保接合時兩端的位置、角度與內力都符合設計。~When the half-arches reached mid-harbour, a gap was left between their tips, and the cables were then slackened step by step so each half rotated inward and downward about its pin until they met at the crown; public sources record that the halves first met on 19 August 1930, after which riveting made the arch self-supporting and the cables were removed. Closure is highly temperature-sensitive: sun expands the steel and narrows the gap by day, and cooling widens it at night, so cable release and connection had to follow temperature to ensure position, angle and internal forces at the joint matched design.
units.model: 放鬆錨索 Δc = 0.10 m、力臂 h = 57 m，半拱繞支承銷轉角 θ = Δc/h ≈ 1.75 mrad。若拱頂端點距支承銷水平 251.5 m、高 120 m，端點向內移動約 θ×120 ≈ 0.21 m，向下約 θ×251.5 ≈ 0.44 m。半拱弧長約 290 m，溫度變化 10 °C 時長度改變 290×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm。幾何為教學假設。~Letting out the cables by Δc = 0.10 m on a lever arm of h = 57 m rotates the half-arch about its pin by θ = Δc/h ≈ 1.75 mrad. With the tip 251.5 m from the pin horizontally and 120 m above it, the tip moves inward by about θ×120 ≈ 0.21 m and down by about θ×251.5 ≈ 0.44 m. A half-arch about 290 m long changes length by 290×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm for a 10 °C change. Geometry is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 合龍前持續量測兩端間隙、高程與鋼溫，建立間隙與溫度、放索量的關係；接合後量測拱頂高程與拱軸線形，確認拱已承載自重並記錄錨索卸載過程中的拉力變化，與設計預測比較。~Before closure measure the gap, levels and steel temperature continuously, building the relation of gap to temperature and cable release; after connection survey crown level and arch axis to confirm the arch carries its own weight, and record cable forces as they unload for comparison with predictions.
units.failure: 若兩端在溫度快速變化時強行接合，接頭鉚接後鎖入額外的內力；兩端高程差或角度差未修正就接合，拱軸偏離設計，造成永久的附加彎矩與局部過應力。~Forcing the connection during rapid temperature change locks extra forces into the riveted joint; connecting with uncorrected level or angle differences shifts the arch axis from design, leaving permanent additional bending and local overstress.
units.misconception: 兩個半拱只要對準就能直接接上，溫度影響可以忽略。~The two half-arches can simply be joined once aligned, and temperature can be ignored.
units.practice: 合龍程序應明訂放索順序與每步量測、可接合的溫度與間隙範圍、臨時固定方式與接合後的錨索卸載步驟；每一步由設計方代表簽認，量測與溫度紀錄完整歸檔。~The closure procedure should specify the cable-release sequence with measurements at each step, the temperature and gap range for connection, temporary fixing and the post-connection cable unloading steps; each step is signed by the designer's representative and all measurements and temperatures are archived.

units.anchor: 機車載重試驗~Locomotive load test
units.title: 1932 年機車載重試驗~The 1932 locomotive load test
units.mechanism: 大橋通車前於 1932 年初進行載重試驗，公開資料記載最多以 96 輛蒸汽機車在四條鐵路軌道上首尾相接排列，試驗持續數週。這種試驗的目的不是證明極限強度，而是以已知的大荷載檢查結構反應是否與計算一致：撓度、拱頂下沉、支承轉動與桿件應變都應呈線性並在卸載後回復。以機車作為試驗荷載有兩個優點：重量可以精確掌握，而且可以依需要排列在半跨或全跨，模擬最不利的鐵路載重。~Before opening, a load test in early 1932 placed up to 96 steam locomotives end to end on the four rail tracks, according to public records, over several weeks. Its purpose was not to prove ultimate strength but to use a large known load to check that structural response agreed with calculation: deflections, crown settlement, support rotation and member strains should be linear and recover on unloading. Locomotives made good test loads for two reasons: their weights were precisely known, and they could be arranged on half or full spans to imitate the most unfavourable rail loading.
units.model: 假設每輛機車含煤水車重 120 t、長 20 m：96 輛共 96×120 = 11,520 t。單一軌道的線荷載約 120×9.81/20 ≈ 58.9 kN/m，四條軌道同時排滿約 235 kN/m。機車重量與長度為教學假設。~Assume each locomotive with tender weighs 120 t and is 20 m long: 96 of them total 96×120 = 11,520 t. One track then carries about 120×9.81/20 ≈ 58.9 kN/m, and four full tracks about 235 kN/m. Locomotive mass and length are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依計算預先列出各荷載排列下拱頂與四分點的預期撓度，試驗時以水準儀量測並記錄氣溫；比較實測與預測的比值，並確認卸載後殘餘變形很小。今日類似試驗會加上應變計與位移計，以自動化記錄取代人工讀數。~List expected crown and quarter-point deflections for each arrangement in advance, measure them by levelling during the test while recording air temperature, compare measured-to-predicted ratios and confirm small residual deformation after unloading. A similar test today would add strain gauges and displacement transducers with automatic logging instead of manual readings.
units.failure: 若試驗期間溫度變化大而未修正，拱的熱變形可能與載重撓度同量級，讓實測值看似異常；機車排列若不對稱且未事先分析，局部桿件或吊桿可能承受超過設計的荷載。~Large temperature changes during the test without correction can produce thermal movements as large as the load deflection, making measurements look abnormal; asymmetric locomotive arrangements not analysed beforehand can overload individual members or hangers.
units.misconception: 載重試驗的目的是把橋加載到接近破壞，以證明它夠強。~A load test aims to load the bridge close to failure to prove it is strong enough.
units.practice: 任何載重試驗都應事先公開荷載排列、預期反應、停止條件與允收準則，試驗荷載不超過設計使用荷載的規定比例；結果與原始紀錄一起永久保存，成為日後評估的基準。~Any load test should publish load arrangements, expected responses, stop criteria and acceptance criteria in advance, keeping the test load within a specified fraction of design service load; results are archived permanently with raw records as the baseline for later assessments.

units.anchor: 鉚接細節疲勞評估~Riveted-detail fatigue assessment
units.title: 現代交通下的疲勞評估~Fatigue assessment under modern traffic
units.mechanism: 大橋設計於 1920 年代，當時的交通量與今日完全不同：公開資料指出 2017 年每日有逾 200 班列車、約 16 萬輛車通過。每一列車或重車通過都在吊桿、橫梁與鐵路縱梁產生應力循環，百年累積的循環次數遠超原設計的想像。鉚接細節的疲勞強度一般歸類為較低的類別，而鉚釘孔、腐蝕坑與鬆動的鉚釘都會降低壽命。因此現代評估會以實測應力與交通資料計算累積損傷，找出最需要檢查與補強的細節。~The bridge was designed in the 1920s for traffic utterly different from today's: public sources cite more than 200 trains and about 160,000 vehicles a day in 2017. Every train or heavy vehicle produces stress cycles in hangers, cross-girders and rail stringers, and a century of accumulation far exceeds anything the original designers imagined. Riveted details usually fall into a lower fatigue category, and rivet holes, corrosion pits and loose rivets reduce life further. Modern assessment therefore computes cumulative damage from measured stresses and traffic data to find the details that most need inspection and strengthening.
units.model: 以 AASHTO 疲勞類別 D（常用於鉚接細節）為例：N = A/Δσ³，A = 21.6×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 7.08×10¹¹ MPa³。等效應力幅 Δσ = 30 MPa 時 N ≈ 7.08×10¹¹/27,000 ≈ 2.62×10⁷ 次；若每日 500 次有效循環，約 2.62×10⁷/(500×365) ≈ 144 年。循環數與應力幅為教學假設。~Using AASHTO fatigue category D, common for riveted details: N = A/Δσ³ with A = 21.6×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 7.08×10¹¹ MPa³. At an equivalent range Δσ = 30 MPa, N ≈ 7.08×10¹¹/27,000 ≈ 2.62×10⁷ cycles; at 500 effective cycles a day that is about 2.62×10⁷/(500×365) ≈ 144 years. Cycle count and stress range are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在代表性吊桿、橫梁與縱梁裝設應變計，記錄數週的列車與車流應力歷時，以雨流計數求等效應力幅與每日循環數；結合歷史交通資料估算已累積的損傷，並以目視、磁粒或渦電流檢測高風險細節。~Fit strain gauges to representative hangers, cross-girders and stringers, record weeks of train and traffic stress histories, and derive equivalent ranges and daily cycles by rainflow counting; estimate accumulated damage with historical traffic data, and inspect high-risk details by visual, magnetic-particle or eddy-current testing.
units.failure: 若只以設計時的交通量評估，歷史累積損傷被低估，疲勞裂紋可能在鉚釘孔邊緣萌生並在構件內擴展而未被發現；腐蝕與疲勞交互作用時，裂紋成長速度更快。~Assessing with design-era traffic underestimates accumulated damage, so fatigue cracks may start at rivet-hole edges and grow undetected; where corrosion and fatigue interact, cracks grow faster still.
units.misconception: 百年老橋沒有倒，代表它不會有疲勞問題。~A century-old bridge that is still standing cannot have fatigue problems.
units.practice: 評估報告應依實測應力與交通量排定細節的檢查優先順序，對高風險細節縮短檢查週期；重大改變交通（例如新增重型列車或車道配置改變）前，必須重新評估疲勞。~The assessment should rank details for inspection using measured stresses and traffic, shortening intervals for high-risk ones; before major traffic changes, such as heavier trains or new lane layouts, fatigue must be reassessed.

units.title: 塗裝與腐蝕維護~Painting and corrosion maintenance
units.mechanism: 雪梨港灣大橋處於海港環境，鹽霧與潮濕讓鋼材持續面臨腐蝕，而鉚接構造的板件搭接縫、鉚釘頭與角落正是積水與鹽分的位置。公開資料指出需要塗裝的鋼材面積約 485,000 平方公尺，每一道塗層約需 30,000 公升油漆，可見塗裝是持續性的大型工程，而不是偶爾的修補。塗裝系統的壽命取決於表面處理品質、膜厚與施工條件；舊漆層可能含鉛，噴砂與清除必須在封閉圍護與廢棄物管制下進行，以保護工人與港灣環境。~The bridge sits in a harbour environment where salt spray and humidity keep the steel under constant corrosion attack, and the lap seams, rivet heads and corners of riveted construction are exactly where water and salt collect. Public sources put the painted steel area at about 485,000 m², needing about 30,000 litres of paint per coat, showing that painting is a continuous major operation rather than occasional touch-up. Coating life depends on surface preparation, film thickness and application conditions; old layers may contain lead, so blasting and removal must happen inside containment with waste control to protect workers and the harbour.
units.model: 平均塗布率 = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L。若油漆體積固體分 50%，理論乾膜厚 DFT = 體積固體分×10/塗布率 = 50×10/16.2 ≈ 31 μm（未計損耗）；若目標系統總乾膜 250 μm，約需 8 道同等塗層的量。固體分與目標膜厚為教學假設。~Average spreading rate = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L. With 50% volume solids, theoretical dry-film thickness DFT = volume solids×10/spreading rate = 50×10/16.2 ≈ 31 μm, ignoring losses; a 250 μm total system would need the equivalent of about 8 such coats. Solids content and target thickness are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 塗裝前檢查表面處理等級與鹽分殘留，施工時量測濕膜與乾膜厚度、環境溫濕度與露點；完成後抽測附著力，並建立分區塗裝紀錄，追蹤各區的劣化與重塗週期。~Before painting check surface preparation grade and residual salts; during application measure wet and dry film thickness, ambient temperature, humidity and dew point; afterwards spot-test adhesion and keep zone-by-zone painting records to track deterioration and recoating cycles.
units.failure: 表面鹽分未清除就塗裝，塗膜下方很快起泡、剝落，腐蝕在漆膜下擴展；搭接縫的隙縫腐蝕產生膨脹力，可能把板件撐開、拉斷鉚釘頭，形成結構性損傷。~Painting over residual salt quickly blisters and lifts the film, spreading corrosion underneath; crevice corrosion in lap seams generates expansion forces that can pry plates apart and pop rivet heads, causing structural damage.
units.misconception: 鋼橋只要定期刷一層新漆，就不會發生腐蝕損傷。~As long as a steel bridge gets a fresh coat of paint regularly, corrosion damage cannot occur.
units.practice: 塗裝維護計畫應以分區劣化調查決定優先順序，規定表面處理、鹽分檢測與膜厚驗收標準，含鉛舊漆的移除須有圍護、監測與廢棄物管理方案；噴砂後先檢查鋼材損失與裂紋再塗裝。~The painting programme should set priorities from zone-by-zone condition surveys, define surface preparation, salt testing and film-thickness acceptance, and require containment, monitoring and waste management for removing lead paint; after blasting, check section loss and cracks before recoating.

units.anchor: 遺產保存與螺栓替換~Heritage conservation and bolt replacement
units.title: 工程遺產的修繕與交接~Repair and handover of engineering heritage
units.mechanism: 大橋在 1988 年被美國土木工程師學會列為國際歷史土木工程地標，並獲澳洲工程遺產的國家工程地標認定，2007 年建立保存管理計畫，現由新南威爾斯州交通部管理。遺產結構的修繕要在安全與真實性之間取得平衡：替換鉚釘時，現代高強度螺栓施工方便、預拉力可靠，但外觀與原有鉚接不同；以熱鉚復原則保存工藝，卻需要稀有技術。每一次修繕都會改變結構的組成，因此需要完整記錄替換了什麼、為什麼、用什麼材料，讓後來的工程師知道哪些部分已非原件。~In 1988 the bridge was named an International Historic Civil Engineering Landmark by the American Society of Civil Engineers and a National Engineering Landmark by Engineering Heritage Australia; a conservation management plan was established in 2007, and the bridge is managed by Transport for NSW. Repairs to heritage structures balance safety with authenticity: modern high-strength bolts are easy to install with reliable preload but look different from rivets, while hot riveting preserves the craft yet needs rare skills. Each repair changes the fabric, so complete records of what was replaced, why and with what material are needed so later engineers know which parts are no longer original.
units.model: 以 M24、8.8 級高強度螺栓替換鉚釘時，預拉力 F_p = 0.7·f_u·A_s = 0.7×800×353 ≈ 197.7 kN；摩擦係數 0.3、單一摩擦面時，每顆抗滑力約 0.3×197.7 ≈ 59 kN。螺栓等級與摩擦係數為教學假設。~Replacing a rivet with an M24 grade 8.8 high-strength bolt gives a preload F_p = 0.7·f_u·A_s = 0.7×800×353 ≈ 197.7 kN; with a friction coefficient of 0.3 and one slip plane, each bolt resists about 0.3×197.7 ≈ 59 kN of slip. Bolt grade and friction coefficient are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 替換前確認接頭的設計力與替換後的剛度差異，避免改變力量分配；螺栓施工以扭矩或轉角法控制預拉力並抽驗；每次修繕更新構件履歷資料庫，標明位置、材料、方法與日期，並由遺產管理單位確認符合保存計畫。~Before replacement confirm the joint's design forces and any stiffness change so force sharing is not altered; control preload by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-check it; after each repair update the component-history database with location, material, method and date, confirmed by the heritage manager as consistent with the conservation plan.
units.failure: 若在同一接頭混用鉚釘與高強度螺栓而未考慮勁度差異，力量會集中在較剛的螺栓，造成局部超載；修繕紀錄缺失時，後人無法分辨原件與替換件，評估時可能錯用材料性質。~Mixing rivets and high-strength bolts in one joint without considering their different stiffness concentrates load on the stiffer bolts and overloads them locally; missing repair records leave later engineers unable to tell original from replaced parts, risking wrong material properties in assessment.
units.misconception: 遺產橋梁只能原樣保存，任何修繕都會破壞其價值。~A heritage bridge must be kept exactly as built, and any repair destroys its value.
units.practice: 修繕方案應依保存管理計畫由結構工程師與遺產專家共同核定，明訂可接受的替換材料與外觀要求；交接文件包含構件履歷、檢查紀錄、塗裝分區、量測基準與遺產登錄要求，供未來的管理者延續。~Repair schemes should be approved jointly by structural engineers and heritage specialists under the conservation management plan, stating acceptable replacement materials and appearance; handover documents include component histories, inspection records, painting zones, measurement baselines and heritage-listing requirements for future managers.

example: 拱橋推力與溫度練習：取跨度 L = 503 m、拱矢 f = 120 m、總荷載 w = 700 kN/m。拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN，每側垂直反力 V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN；每側兩片桁架分擔，單一支承合力 ≈ √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN。若拱矢減為 110 m，H 升到約 201,300 kN，增加約 9%，說明矢跨比對推力很敏感。溫度方面，拋物線拱弧長 s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 503 + 8×120²/(3×503) ≈ 579.3 m；升溫 30 °C 時弧長增加 Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×579.3×30 ≈ 0.209 m，跨度固定時拱矢增加 Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×503×0.209/(16×120) ≈ 0.164 m，與公開資料所說熱天拱頂升高約 18 公分同量級。數值為教學假設，不代表雪梨港灣大橋的設計計算。~Arch thrust and temperature exercise: take span L = 503 m, rise f = 120 m and total load w = 700 kN/m. A parabolic arch has thrust H = w·L²/(8f) = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN and vertical reaction per side V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN; with two trusses per side, one bearing's resultant is about √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN. Reducing the rise to 110 m raises H to about 201,300 kN, about 9% more, showing how sensitive thrust is to the rise-to-span ratio. For temperature, the parabolic arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 503 + 8×120²/(3×503) ≈ 579.3 m; a 30 °C rise lengthens it by Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×579.3×30 ≈ 0.209 m, and with the span fixed the rise grows by Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×503×0.209/(16×120) ≈ 0.164 m, the same order as the roughly 18 cm crown rise on hot days cited publicly. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of the bridge.
history: 跨越雪梨港的構想可追溯到 19 世紀，新南威爾斯公共工程部總工程師 J. J. C. Bradfield 長期推動，1922 年通過大橋法案。1924 年國際招標由英國 Dorman Long 公司以拱橋方案得標，其顧問工程師 Ralph Freeman 負責細部設計與架設；1923 年開始引道工程，1928 年開始架設鋼拱，1930 年 8 月兩半拱合龍，1932 年初以 96 輛機車做載重試驗，3 月 19 日通車。其工程意義在於以 U 形岩盤隧道錨碇鋼索懸臂架設當時世界級跨度的鋼拱、同時承載公路與鐵路，以及延續至今的大規模維護管理。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。~A harbour crossing was proposed from the nineteenth century, and J. J. C. Bradfield, chief engineer of the New South Wales Public Works Department, championed it for years until the Sydney Harbour Bridge Act passed in 1922. An international tender in 1924 was won by the British firm Dorman Long with an arch design, its consulting engineer Ralph Freeman leading detailed design and erection; approach works began in 1923, arch erection in 1928, the half-arches met in August 1930, a load test with 96 locomotives followed in early 1932, and the bridge opened on 19 March 1932. Its significance lies in cantilevering a steel arch of world-class span with cables anchored in U-shaped rock tunnels, carrying road and rail together, and a large-scale maintenance regime that continues today. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.
facts: 拱跨 503 公尺，含引橋全長約 1,149 公尺~Arch span 503 m, with a total length of about 1,149 m including approaches
拱頂高出水面約 134 公尺，橋面寬約 49 公尺~The crown is about 134 m above the water, and the deck is about 49 m wide
鋼構總重約 52,800 公噸，其中拱約 39,000 公噸~The steelwork weighs about 52,800 t, of which about 39,000 t is in the arch
約 600 萬顆手工打製的鉚釘~About 6 million hand-driven rivets
拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺，兩端深約 57 公尺~The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m at the ends
架設時以 128 條錨碇於岩盤隧道的鋼索支撐半拱~During erection 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels held back the half-arches
四座花崗岩飾面橋塔高約 89 公尺，屬建築性而非結構性~The four granite-faced pylons are about 89 m tall and architectural rather than structural
1932 年以最多 96 輛蒸汽機車在 4 條軌道上做載重試驗~In 1932 up to 96 steam locomotives on 4 tracks were used for the load test
需塗裝鋼材面積約 485,000 平方公尺，每道塗層約 30,000 公升~About 485,000 m² of steel needs painting, about 30,000 litres per coat

timeline.event: 7 月 28 日舉行動土典禮，引道工程開始~First sod turned on 28 July, starting the approach works
